setup.command: set -eu; version=v1.6.0; root=/usr/local/lib/codegraph; bin=/usr/local/bin; command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q git-lfs); command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q curl); case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) arch=x64 ;; arm64|aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) printf 'Unsupported CodeGraph architecture: %s\n' "$(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; expected="${version#v}"; installed=''; if [ -x "$bin/codegraph" ]; then installed="$($bin/codegraph --version 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi; if [ "$installed" != "$expected" ]; then archive="$(mktemp)"; destination="$root/versions/$version"; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/releases/download/$version/codegraph-linux-$arch.tar.gz" -o "$archive"; rm -rf "$destination"; mkdir -p "$destination" "$bin"; tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$destination" --strip-components=1; ln -sfn "$destination" "$root/current"; ln -sfn "$destination/bin/codegraph" "$bin/codegraph"; rm -f "$archive"; fi; "$bin/codegraph" telemetry off >/dev/null; if [ ! -f .codegraph/codegraph.db ]; then "$bin/codegraph" init -y; fi
